verifyAndDecode(bytes32,bytes).details: Intentionally `nonpayable`, not `view`: the production prover must      call the CC3 BlockProver precompile's `verifyAndEmit`, which emits a      verification event. Solidity requires overrides to keep identical      mutability, so the whole interface is nonpayable.

params.sourceTxHash: The source-chain transaction hash being proven.

returns.action: The decoded AuthorityUpdated payload from the proven tx.
returns.verified: True only if the proof is cryptographically valid.

verifyAndDecode(bytes32,bytes).notice: Verify an Attestcoin proof and decode the source transaction data.
